hero.subtitle: Upload your photos, and we'll turn them into a refined printed album, crafted to feel timeless and made to be kept

steps.title: You upload
steps.body: All your photos, unorganized — duplicates, blurry shots, HDR. We accept everything.

steps.title: We sort
steps.body: Gemini analyzes each shot: composition, duplicates, and grouping by scene.

steps.title: You flip
steps.body: A 3D preview, varied layouts, and a high-resolution PDF export.

sorting.intro: You can upload everything — hundreds of photos, duplicates, near-identical bursts, the odd blurry shot — and skip the sorting yourself. Here's exactly what we do to turn that into a book, step by step, without ever touching the resolution of the images you'll actually print.

steps.title: Finding near-duplicates and bursts
steps.body: Every photo gets a visual fingerprint, and shots taken close together in time are compared to each other. Near-identical frames — the same moment shot two or three times — are grouped together automatically.

steps.title: Picking the sharpest one
steps.body: Within each group, we measure focus and clarity directly and keep the sharpest frame. The rest are quietly set aside rather than deleted.

steps.title: Sorting by date and place
steps.body: The surviving, distinct photos are then ordered chronologically. Where a photo carries location data, it's grouped with others taken at the same place before sorting by time — so your book follows the order things actually happened, place by place.

steps.title: Filtering out clear misses
steps.body: Shots that are dramatically out of focus — severe motion blur, a finger over the lens — are left out of the automatic layout, based on the same sharpness check used to pick between near-duplicates. Nothing is ever permanently deleted — everything set aside during sorting stays available for you to add back in the editor if you disagree.

templates.intro: Pick a starting look for your trip, your couple, your family, or a celebration — then customize every detail in the book editor: colors, title, photos, layout.

A5, A4 and A3, in either portrait or landscape orientation. You choose the format when you create your album, and can see it reflected live in the editor.

items.q: Can I edit my album after placing an order?
items.a: Once an order is placed, your album is sent into production shortly after, so further edits won't be reflected in that particular order. If you need a change, contact us as soon as possible and we'll do our best to help.

items.q: How does the AI photo selection work?
items.a: When you import a large batch of photos, we automatically detect near-duplicates and bursts, keep the sharpest shot from each, and use AI to help group and describe the best of what's left — so you spend less time sorting and more time enjoying the result.

items.q: Can I order more than one copy?

terms.title: Terms of sale

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body:
Through the Site, the Company offers a service allowing users to select and upload their photographs, customise the layout of a photo album, where applicable with the help of artificial intelligence tools, order its printing and receive the printed album at the delivery address given when ordering.

Albums are made to order according to the choices the customer makes when customising their album, as finally approved by them.

Printing and, where applicable, all or part of the manufacturing or delivery may be carried out by partner providers selected by the Company, in particular a partner printing house located in Lebanon.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body:
These Terms apply to any order placed on the Site by a consumer.

They are available to the customer before their order is finally confirmed.

Ordering on the Site is reserved for persons with the legal capacity to enter into contracts. By ordering, the customer declares that they are of legal age in their country of residence or, failing that, are acting with the authorisation of their legal representative.

The Company reserves the right to change these Terms. The version that applies to an order is the one accepted by the customer when confirming that order.

When the customer orders from a country other than Lebanon, any mandatory consumer-protection provisions of their country of habitual residence remain applicable, in accordance with article 22.

sections.heading: 3. Creating and customising the album
4. Artificial intelligence assistance
sections.body:
The Site may offer the customer features based on artificial intelligence tools, in particular to suggest a selection of photographs, an order, a layout or elements of the album's composition.

These features are an aid to creation. They do not replace the customer's choice: the customer can at any time change, complete or discard the suggestions made by these tools before finally confirming their order, in accordance with article 3.

The Company cannot guarantee that the suggestions generated by these tools fully match the customer's aesthetic or personal expectations. It is up to the customer to check the final result before printing.

Unless the customer gives express and separate consent for this purpose, the photographs uploaded by the customer are not used to train, retrain or improve artificial intelligence models intended for any use other than processing the current order. How these tools process photographs is detailed in the Privacy Policy.

The layout or composition elements generated by the Site's artificial intelligence tools from the customer's choices may be used freely by the customer in their album; for the rest, they remain governed by article 18 on the Site's intellectual property.

sections.heading: 5. Quality of photographs
sections.body:
The quality of the printed product depends in particular on the quality and resolution of the files provided by the customer.

When the Site indicates that a photograph has insufficient resolution or may lead to reduced print quality, a customer who nevertheless decides to keep that photograph accepts the corresponding risk.

The Company cannot be held liable for a quality defect directly attributable to a file of insufficient quality provided or approved by the customer.

This provision does not limit the Company's liability for a defect resulting from the printing process itself.

sections.heading: 6. Content uploaded by the customer
sections.body:
The customer remains the owner of the photographs and other content they upload to the Site.

Uploading content to the Site does not transfer any intellectual property to the Company.

However, for the time strictly necessary to fulfil the order, the customer grants the Company a limited authorisation to use, reproduce, store and transmit the files concerned, including, where applicable, through the tools described in article 4, solely in order to create, print, check, manufacture and deliver the ordered album.

The Company may not use the customer's photographs for advertising, commercial or promotional purposes, nor to train artificial intelligence models other than as described in article 4, without the customer's prior, free and express consent.

sections.heading: 7. Rights to photographs and content
sections.body:
The customer declares that they hold the rights and authorisations needed for the photographs, texts and other content they provide on the Site, including, where applicable, the consent of people recognisable in the photographs or, for minors shown in them, of their legal representatives.

In particular, the customer undertakes not to upload content that infringes intellectual property rights, image rights, privacy or any other right belonging to a third party.

The customer also undertakes not to use the service to create content that breaks the applicable laws.

The customer indemnifies the Company against any claim, action or judgment resulting from a breach of the declarations and undertakings in this article, to the extent permitted by the applicable law.

The Company reserves the right to refuse or cancel an order when it finds that content is manifestly unlawful or that printing it would be prohibited by law.

In that case, the financial consequences of the cancellation will be determined according to how far the order has progressed and the applicable mandatory legal provisions.

sections.heading: 8. Order
sections.body:
Before ordering, the customer can view a preview of their album and the main characteristics of the selected product.

The customer is invited to check and, where needed, correct their order before finally confirming it.

The order becomes final after:
• the customer has checked the order summary;
• these Terms have been accepted;
• the order has been confirmed; and
• payment has been confirmed, when it is required immediately.

An order confirmation is sent to the customer electronically at the address given when ordering.

The Company reserves the right to refuse an order, in particular in the event of refused payment, suspected fraud, technical impossibility of manufacturing or manifestly unlawful content.

sections.heading: 9. Approval of the file before printing
sections.body:
By finally approving their album, the customer confirms that the version shown, including any elements resulting from an artificial intelligence suggestion they accepted or changed, is the version they want printed.

After this approval, and once the order has been sent to production, the customisation elements can in principle no longer be changed.

Any change requested after approval will be considered by the Company, with no guarantee that it can be made.

sections.heading: 10. Prices
sections.body:
The applicable prices are those shown on the Site at the time of ordering.

Prices are shown in USD, all taxes included.

Before confirming the order, the customer is informed of the total price of their purchase, including the price of the album, any options chosen, applicable taxes and delivery costs. Delivery within Lebanon costs USD 5 per order.

The Company may change its prices at any time. A later price change does not, however, affect an order already confirmed.

sections.heading: 11. Payment
sections.body:
Payment is made in cash or by bank card, using the payment methods shown on the Site at the time of ordering.

Payment may be processed by a third-party payment provider. The Company does not intend to keep the customer's full card details when payment is processed directly by that provider.

The order may be suspended or cancelled if payment is refused or fails.

sections.heading: 12. Manufacturing
sections.body:
As albums are personalised from the customer's choices and photographs, their manufacturing starts after the order has been confirmed and payment has been confirmed.

The Company may entrust the printing and manufacturing of the album to a partner printing house located in Lebanon.

Using a provider for printing does not change the consumer's rights towards the Company where the Company acts as the contractual seller of the album.

sections.heading: 13. Delivery
sections.body:
Delivery is currently available in Lebanon only.

Products are delivered to the address given by the customer when ordering.

The customer is responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the delivery information they provide.

The available delivery areas and the corresponding costs are shown on the Site before the order is confirmed.

The estimated manufacturing and delivery time is shown to the customer before or when ordering. As a guide, manufacturing takes about 5 days and delivery 2 to 3 days.

The announced times may be affected by circumstances beyond the Company's control. In the event of a significant delay, the customer's rights are those provided by the applicable mandatory provisions of Lebanese law.

sections.heading: 14. Receipt – Damaged or non-conforming product
sections.body:
The customer is invited to check the condition of their parcel and album on receipt.

If the album is damaged, has a printing defect or does not match the approved order, the customer is invited to contact the Company within 14 days of receipt at orders@everbook-album.com, giving their order number and, where possible, photographs showing the problem.

Where a defect or non-conformity is attributable to the Company or one of its providers, the Company will offer, depending on the circumstances and in accordance with the applicable law, a reprint, replacement, repair or refund of the product concerned.

This provision does not limit any mandatory right the consumer has under Lebanese law.

sections.heading: 15. Cancellation and right of withdrawal
sections.body:
The albums offered on the Site are made to order from the customer's photographs, format, layout and other individual choices, including when these choices result in whole or in part from an artificial intelligence suggestion accepted by the customer.

Law no. 659/2005 on consumer protection grants consumers, for distance purchases, a right to cancel within ten (10) days, excluding in particular personalised or made-to-order goods (article 55 of Law no. 659/2005). The album ordered on the Site, made from the customer's own photographs and choices, falls under this exclusion.

Consequently, the right of cancellation that applies by law to distance sales cannot be exercised by the customer for the personalised album once the order has been confirmed under the conditions of article 8.

The customer may nevertheless ask to cancel their order before manufacturing starts by contacting the Company at orders@everbook-album.com.

The Company will make its best efforts to stop the order. Cancellation cannot, however, be guaranteed once manufacturing has started.

This article does not deprive the customer of their rights when a product is defective, damaged or does not match the order.

sections.heading: 16. Personal data and photographs
17. Retention and deletion of photographs
18. Intellectual property of the Site
sections.body:
The Site, its software, interface, graphic elements, layout templates, brand, logo, the artificial intelligence tools it uses and the other elements created by or for the Company are protected by the applicable intellectual property rights.

Nothing in these Terms grants the customer any ownership of these elements, except the right to use, in their album, the layout suggestions generated from their own content in accordance with article 4.

This provision does not affect the rights of the customer or of third parties in the photographs and content uploaded by the customer.

sections.heading: 19. Liability
20. Force majeure
sections.body:
Neither party can be held liable for a delay or failure to perform resulting from a force majeure event recognised as such by Lebanese law.

The party concerned informs the other party within a reasonable time of the event and its foreseeable consequences for the order.

If the impediment lasts so long that the order can no longer reasonably be fulfilled, the consequences of ending the contract are determined in accordance with the applicable law.

sections.heading: 21. Customer service and complaints
sections.body:
For any question or complaint about an order, the customer can contact the Company:
Email: orders@everbook-album.com

The customer is invited to give their order number so that their request can be handled more easily.

sections.heading: 22. Applicable law
sections.body:
These Terms and the orders placed through the Site are governed by Lebanese law.

Where the customer is a consumer habitually resident in a country other than Lebanon, the choice of Lebanese law cannot deprive them of the protection afforded by the mandatory provisions of the law of their country of residence that cannot be derogated from by contract.

sections.heading: 23. Dispute resolution
sections.body:
In the event of a dispute, the customer is invited to first contact customer service to seek an amicable solution.

Failing an amicable settlement, the dispute will be submitted to the competent courts in accordance with the rules of jurisdiction applicable under Lebanese law.

Nothing in this article can deprive a consumer of a mandatory rule of jurisdiction from which they benefit, in particular, where applicable, that of their country of habitual residence.

sections.heading: 24. General provisions
sections.body:
If any provision of these Terms is declared void, unlawful or unenforceable, the other provisions remain applicable to the fullest extent permitted by law.

The Company's failure to exercise immediately a right under these Terms does not constitute a waiver of that right.

These Terms, together with the order confirmation and the other contractual documents expressly incorporated, form the agreement applicable to the order between the Company and the customer.

These Terms are written in French and translated into English. In case of any discrepancy between the two versions, the French version prevails.

terms.intro:
These General Terms and Conditions of Sale (the "Terms") govern orders for personalised photo albums placed on the Everbook website, available at everbook-album.com (the "Site"), operated by EFFET DESIGN, registered with the Lebanese commercial registry under number 1015439, with its registered office at Achrafieh, building 5134, Sioufi Street, Lebanon (the "Company").

By placing an order on the Site, the customer acknowledges having read these Terms and accepts them.

The Site uses artificial intelligence tools to help the customer select, organise and/or lay out their photographs (see article 4). The use of these tools is presented to the customer transparently and does not affect their right to approve, change or reject any suggestion before their album is printed.

This is an English translation of the French Conditions Générales de Vente. In case of any discrepancy, the French version prevails.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body:
Everbook ("we", "us", "our") designs and prints custom photo albums, operated by EFFET DESIGN, registered in Lebanon under commercial registry number 1015439, with its registered office at Achrafieh, building 5134, Sioufi Street, Lebanon. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through everbook-album.com and our related services (together, the "Service"), why we collect it, how long we keep it, who we share it with, and the choices available to you. For any question about this policy or your data, you can contact us through our Contact page.

This is an English translation of our French privacy policy. In case of any discrepancy, the French version prevails.

sections.heading: 2. Information we collect
sections.body:
Account information: your name, your email address and your account password (stored as a secure one-way hash, never in plain text) when you create an account directly; or your name, your email address and a unique account identifier when you sign in with Google — in that case we never see or store your Google password.

Photos and album content: the photos, captions, titles and layout choices you upload or create while building an album, including the photos you choose to import from Google Photos (see section 4). Photo files may contain metadata recorded by your camera or phone, such as the date the photo was taken and, if your device recorded it, its GPS location. We also generate technical data from your photos — such as sharpness scores, similarity/duplicate signals and where faces are in the picture — only to help our editor suggest layouts, frame the photos and spot likely duplicate photos. Face detection is used only for framing: it never identifies anyone.

Order and delivery information: your delivery address, your phone number and the order details (album format, number of pages, price, currency, the version of the terms of sale you accepted and when you accepted it) needed to produce and deliver your album.

Feedback and support messages: anything you write to us through the Contact page, by email or through the feedback form offered after your order is delivered.

Technical information: standard web request data such as your IP address, browser type and device type, collected automatically by our hosting and security infrastructure to keep the Service running reliably and securely (for example in server logs). When a technical error occurs, an error report (error message, page concerned, browser, device and IP address) is sent to our error-monitoring service (Sentry) so that we can fix it. We use no third-party advertising trackers and never sell any data collected this way.

Storage in your browser: the Service saves in your browser's local storage your sign-in session, your language choice, the user guides you have already seen and, where applicable, a backup copy of changes to your album that could not be saved yet (for example when your connection drops). This information stays on your device and is not used for any advertising tracking.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to: create and secure your account; let you build, save and edit your album; process, produce and ship your order; send you service emails — welcome email, email address verification (only if you sign up with an email and password), order confirmation, shipping and delivery updates, a feedback request after delivery, a reminder when an album you started is unfinished or about to be deleted, password reset and password-changed confirmations, and account deletion confirmation; respond to your questions and feedback; and detect and prevent fraud, abuse or technical problems. We do not use your photos or personal information for advertising, and we do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 4. Google user data (Sign in with Google and import from Google Photos)
sections.body:
Sign in with Google — what we access: if you choose to sign in with Google, we request only your basic Google profile information through Google's standard OpenID Connect sign-in — your name, your email address and a unique Google account identifier. We do not access your Gmail, Google Drive, Google contacts or any other Google Workspace data, and we never see or store your Google password.

Import from Google Photos: if you choose to add photos from Google Photos, you select them yourself in Google's official picker. We retrieve only the photos you selected, to add them to your album; we have no access to any other photo, album or information in your Google Photos account. The access permission provided by Google is used only for the duration of that import and is not kept. Imported photos are then handled exactly like the photos you upload from your device.

How we use it: we use this information only to create and authenticate your Everbook account, recognise you when you sign in again, add the photos you chose to your album, and send you the service emails described in section 3. We do not use Google user data to train any artificial intelligence or machine learning model, and we do not use it for advertising or profiling.

Who we share it with: we do not share, transfer, sell or disclose Google user data to any third party, and we do not send your Google account data to the Gemini API or any other AI service (see section 6 for the exact use of the Gemini API — it never receives Google account data, only an anonymised comparison of two of your photos, and only in ambiguous duplicate-detection cases). Photos you import from Google Photos follow the same path as your other photos (printing and delivery of your order, section 6). The only exception is where the law requires it, or to protect the rights, property or safety of Everbook, our users or others.

Retention and deletion: we keep the Google profile information linked to your account for as long as your account exists; imported photos are kept under the same rules as your other photos (section 5). If you delete your Everbook account from your account page or ask us to delete your data (section 8), we delete this information as part of that process. You can also revoke Everbook's access to your Google account at any time from the "Third-party apps & services" settings of your Google account; this prevents any new sign-in with Google but does not automatically delete your Everbook account.

Optional access: Sign in with Google and importing from Google Photos are options. The whole Service is available with an account created with an email and password, and by uploading your photos from your device.

sections.heading: 5. How long we keep your information
sections.body:
Albums in progress: an album you have not ordered is automatically deleted, together with its photos, 30 days after it was created.

Unused photos: photos you uploaded that were not included in the final layout of an ordered album are deleted once your order's print file has been generated.

Ordered albums: once you place an order, we keep the album, its photos and the order history for as long as your account exists, so that you can find your album again or ask for a reprint, and so that we can handle any after-sales question.

Account information: kept for as long as your account exists. You can delete your account at any time from your account page ("Delete my account"): your account, albums and photos are then permanently deleted. The basic information of your past orders (date, amount, product ordered, delivery address, status) is kept for as long as our legal, accounting and tax obligations require, without any photo. Deletion is not possible while an order is being produced or delivered.

Contact and feedback messages: kept for as long as reasonably necessary to handle your request and keep a history of exchanges with our support.

sections.heading: 6. Who we share your information with
sections.body:
We only share what each party needs to do its job, and we never sell your data:

• Our printing partner receives your order's final print file (your photos and layout) to produce your physical album.
• Our delivery partner receives your name, delivery address and phone number to deliver your order.
• Google, when you choose to sign in with Google or import photos from Google Photos, confirms your identity to us or sends us the photos you selected; how we handle this data is described in section 4.
• Google's Gemini API: this service is separate from Sign in with Google and never receives your Google account data. While your album is being created, a small number of your uploaded photos may be compared automatically to detect possible duplicates. When our own systems cannot decide with certainty between two very similar photos, an anonymised visual comparison of those two photos only (without your name, email address or any Google account or sign-in data) is sent to Google's Gemini API, only to help decide which photo to suggest keeping. This only concerns ambiguous cases, not all your photos, and only to provide this feature of the Service — never for advertising or to train third-party models with your data. We access the Gemini API through a paid plan (Google Cloud): under the terms of service that apply to this plan, Google does not use the data sent this way to train or improve its own models; only time-limited retention for abuse detection and security purposes may apply on Google's side. This processing is based on our legitimate interest in improving the quality of the album we deliver to you.
• Our error-monitoring service (Sentry) receives the technical error reports described in section 2, only so that we can fix problems with the Service.
• Our infrastructure providers that host our application, database and file storage (including our cloud hosting and object storage providers) process data on our behalf, under contractual confidentiality obligations, and do not use it for their own purposes.

We may also disclose information if the law requires it, or to protect the rights, property or safety of Everbook, our users or others.

sections.heading: 7. How we protect your information
sections.body:
We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, including: encryption of data in transit via HTTPS across the whole Service; storing passwords as irreversible cryptographic hashes, never in plain text; and restricting access to your photos and files through private, non-public cloud storage, with signed and time-limited access links rather than permanent public URLs.

The order information needed to produce and deliver your album (such as your delivery address and the files concerned) is sent to our printing and delivery partners by email. We are working to strengthen this transmission process.

Sensitive data such as your password and sign-in credentials are never stored in plain text or shared outside Everbook. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we strive to protect your information according to industry standards.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights and choices
sections.body: You can view and update your account information (name, email, password) at any time from your account page. You can ask us to correct inaccurate information. You can delete your account and the associated data yourself — including any Google sign-in data we hold — from your account page ("Delete my account"), or ask us to do it through our Contact page; we will respond to and handle reasonable requests within a reasonable time. If you signed up with Google, you can also revoke the permissions granted to Everbook at any time directly from your Google account settings.

sections.heading: 9. Children's privacy
sections.body:
The Service is intended for a general audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors who are below the age required to consent to such processing in their country of residence. If you believe a child has given us personal information, please contact us so that we can delete it.

Sign in with Google is an optional feature. The whole Service remains available without a Google account, in line with the requirements that apply to general-audience services.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, for example to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. If we make significant changes, we will update the "last updated" date at the top of this page and, where relevant, invite you to review the permissions linked to your Google account again. We encourage you to check this page periodically.

sections.heading: 11. Contact us
sections.body: For any question about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us through our Contact page or at orders@everbook-album.com; we will be happy to help.

sections.heading: 1. Custom-made products
sections.body: Each album is printed specifically for you from your own photos. Because of this, we cannot accept returns for a simple change of mind once an order has been placed.

sections.heading: 2. Damaged or defective albums
sections.body: If your album arrives damaged, or if there's a genuine printing defect, email us at orders@everbook-album.com within 14 days of delivery with photos of the issue. We'll review it and arrange a reprint or a refund as appropriate.

sections.heading: 3. How to reach us
sections.body: Email us at orders@everbook-album.com, or use our Contact page, with your order number and a description (and photos, if relevant) of the problem.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery area
sections.body: We currently deliver within Lebanon only.

sections.heading: 2. Production and delivery time
sections.body: Producing your album takes about 5 days once your order is placed, followed by 2 to 3 days for delivery. You can follow your order's status from your Orders page.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery cost
sections.body: Delivery within Lebanon costs USD 5 per order. This amount is shown in the summary before you order and included in the total.

sections.heading: 4. If delivery fails
sections.body: If we're unable to deliver to the address you provided, we'll contact you using the phone number or email on your account to arrange a new delivery.

welcome.title: Welcome to the editor
welcome.body: Your album has been laid out for you. This one-minute guide shows how to make it yours. You can replay it at any time with the "Guide" button.

book.title: Your album
book.body: Here is your album, as it will be printed. To flip through it, use the arrows just below. The first page is the cover: click it to change its colors or title, or to add text and images.

firstPage.title: Your first page
firstPage.body: Right after the cover, it holds your album's title and a short introduction. Double-click a text to rewrite it, drag it to move it, or delete it. You can also add photos to it: drag them from the gallery below.

photo.title: Edit a photo
photo.body: Click a photo to select it, like this one. Drag it to move it and pull its corners to resize it. The bar that appears above it lets you zoom and crop, swap it with another photo, bring it forward or backward, or delete it. Double-click a photo to swap it straight away.

pageTools.title: Page tools
pageTools.body: On the edge of each page: change the layout (how many photos and how they're arranged), add a text box, or delete the page.

pageNav.title: Move between pages
pageNav.body: Use these arrows to go from one spread to the next.

pageCount.title: Number of pages
pageCount.body: Need more or fewer pages? Change the total here: the album is laid out again automatically.

rearrange.title: Rearrange your photos
rearrange.body: Drag and drop these thumbnails to change the order of the photos across the whole album. Hover a thumbnail to see it larger.

gallery.title: All your photos
gallery.body: Every photo you uploaded, including the ones the AI didn't use (no check mark). Click a photo then a frame on the page to place it, or drag it straight onto the page.

addPhotos.title: Add more photos
addPhotos.body: From your computer, your phone (QR code) or Google Photos. The AI picks the best ones and adds pages at the end of the album.

tools.title: Your tools
tools.body: Undo and redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), save (the album also saves automatically) and add text anywhere in the book.

order.title: Order
order.body: When everything looks right, order your album: we prepare the print file at full resolution.

help.title: Replay this guide
help.body: Click here at any time to replay this guide. Enjoy!

welcome.title: Make your cover
welcome.body: Here is your cover laid flat, as it will be printed: the back cover on the left, the spine in the middle and the front cover on the right.

front.title: The front cover
front.body: Click the title to change its font, size or text (double-click to type it directly). Drag any element to move it and pull its corners to resize it.

spine.title: The spine
spine.body: Click the spine to change its title, font and size, or to add a text to it.

back.title: The back cover
back.body: Click the background to add a text or an image to the back of your album.

panel.title: Settings
panel.body: When an element is selected, its settings appear here: background and text colors, font, size, adding text or an image, and "Reset position" to put it back where it was.

next.title: Next step
next.body: When you like your cover, continue to add your photos. You can still change it later in the editor.

help.title: Replay this guide
help.body: Click here at any time to replay this guide.
